items.title: WHL wildcard preview
items.html:
Two 5-vs-4 series split the spotlight. Swift Current faces Red Deer in the East, while Victoria meets Penticton in the West. Each series is first to four wins.

  • No. 6 Chilliwack Bruins vs. No. 3 Edmonton Oil Kings
  • No. 5 Swift Current Broncos vs. No. 4 Red Deer Rebels
  • No. 6 Kelowna Rockets vs. No. 2 Tri City Americans
  • No. 5 Victoria Royals vs. No. 4 Penticton Vees

items.title: OHL wildcard preview
items.html:
Sarnia opens against Erie, while Sudbury draws Brampton. Both No. 2 seeds face a wildcard series before they can advance. Each series is first to four wins.

  • No. 6 Kingston Frontenacs vs. No. 3 North Bay Battalion
  • No. 4 Brampton Steelheads vs. No. 2 Sudbury Wolves
  • No. 6 Erie Otters vs. No. 2 Sarnia Sting
  • No. 5 Flint Firebirds vs. No. 4 Saginaw Spirit

Game schedules and results →

items.title: QMJHL wildcard preview
items.html:
The two conferences have the same seed pairings. Both No. 3 seeds draw a No. 6, and both No. 4 seeds open against a No. 5. Each series is first to four wins.

  • No. 6 Charlottetown Islanders vs. No. 3 Cape Breton Eagles
  • No. 5 Quebec Remparts vs. No. 4 Chicoutimi Sagueneens
  • No. 6 Shawinigan Cataractes vs. No. 3 Victoriaville Tigres
  • No. 5 Blainville-Boisbriand Armada vs. No. 4 Val-d'Or Foreurs
